runs.summary: NCM vs AR on CPU: MiniMSRQ tokenizer fixed vendored-quantizer collapse; Qwen warm-start 32 tensors; NCM x1.34/sample (~x3.5/token-equiv) at 0.658s vs 0.884s; quality weak at 60M/4MB scale - honest limits documented.
Resumed both arms to step 1000: AR loss 3.30->2.11, NCM 5.69->5.52; symmetric bench NCM x1.05/sample (~x2.6/token-equiv); quality ceiling confirmed at 60M/4MB scale.
Corpus +47% (4,665 rec); both gens to step 2000 (AR loss ~1.8, NCM ~5.4); NCM x1.14/sample; continuous +1000-step regime armed for days of training.
Scale investigation: billions infeasible on 23GB (paper max ~600M anyway); launched 471M NCM (paper-class) training verified learning; AR+bench delegated to armed queue

MoE→NCM conversion research: vocabulary-pyramid codebook built from Qwen embeddings (no VQ-VAE) + level-heads learning verified on frozen backbone (coarse-first signature); RAG built; full-scale head training delegated to background compute
ThinkPad setup: ambiente pesquisa restaurado; decode_pyramid mede -34% vs AR (negativo informativo); spec-decode 1.7B=0.94x; usuario ja roda 30B-A3B com expert_used=4
Spec-decode piramidal medido: correto (equal_ar) mas accept=0 em depth 1/2/6 — gargalo e a ultima milha codigo->token (32% top-1), nao as heads; spec ~0.95 tok/fwd vs AR ~4 tok/s

Mimir-1.6B LCM rodando offline em podman: 0.07 conceitos/s fp32 CPU; licoes: SONAR resolve ultima milha com decoder seq2seq inteiro (move custo, nao elimina) — caminho nosso = decoder leve condicionado em codigos RVQ

Code-path likelihood decode: 0/40 top-1 (3 decoders independentes falham igual); rank mediano token AR ~43k — gargalo e informacao nas distribuicoes de codigo, nao o metodo de decode; beam hierarquico 0.7s/pos e a variante nativa

Ablacao da ultima milha: codes-head aprendeu (loss 6.6, top-1 truth 3.1%) enquanto feat-only nunca aprendeu — codigos RVQ carregam sinal real; insuficiente para spec (a1=0, accept=0) mas a curva nao saturou
Codes-head resume 1500-3000: estagnou (t1 3,125->2,34%, a1=0); spec tokhead accept=0 equal_ar; gargalo estrutural, nao de steps
Lit-guided lever (DistillSpec soft-CE + SpecInfer topk): first a1>0 (3,1%) and first accept>0 (0,58@k64) with equal_ar; frontier rescue costs fwd extra - spec still ~2x slower; tree-verify is next

Lit-grounded efficient-training recipe for closed-scope NCM: TinyStories/python-edu corpus + 30B synthetic slice (15,7 tok/s measured), own BPE 4-16k, native NCM 30-100M w/ co-trained decoder, WSD <=4 epochs, ETA 2-5 days
NCM nativo TinyStories end-to-end: pipeline completo (BPE8k+MiniMSRQ+AR/NCM pareados); NCM 2.82x mais rapido mas word-salad — speedup real, qualidade insuficiente nos niveis finos.
Ablacao: niveis finos essenciais (k6=97% vs k5=36%). Dois bracos (codebooks afunilados x3.22 / 2x steps x3.21) falharam igual — gargalo informacional, direciona RUN-016 intra-level.
Intra-level NCM trained/benched: x1.22, word-salad persists; GT-boundary CE diagnostic proves fine residual codes unpredictable; interp area->linear bug fixed post-hoc.
official-tokenizer codes + corruption: fine levels learned but l0 uniform -> word-salad; blind review found init-order bug scrambling vqvae in ALL runs; fixed, retrain gen_ncm_v2 launched

init-order fix verified+retrain launched (gen_ncm_v2, in-flight ~13h); bench chain armed; verdict deferred; blind-review majors were doc-inconsistencies; framework deadlock at blind_review worked around
monitoring run: treino saudavel (l11=2.60<oficial @57%); fechada com veredito deferred ~5h — bench_v2 chain armada, escrever secao RUN-019 no report.md quando amostras existirem

verdict v2: NOT word-salad — real story structure/vocab/dialogue but massive stutter + no narrative arc; bug was the cause of pure salad, remaining gap is scale (l0~uniform, 2000x less compute than official)
